title: Native derived forgetting and cohomology of ordinary Frobenius pairs
statement: For a finite field k0, an invertible prime ell and a k0-scheme X, let F be native ordinary Frobenius pullback [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Define the pair category IsoAlgebra D(F). Apply homology via the canonical exact-functor commutation isomorphism to obtain ordinary Weil sheaves. Exact native forgetting U induces a functor to these derived pairs, with action D(U)D(F) -> D(UF) -> D(U) induced by the termwise structure natural isomorphism.

proof.text: Use mapDerivedCategoryCompIso inverse and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso of strNatIso for theta. Its naturality makes the forgetful morphisms intertwine. For homology apply IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso to the exact Frobenius homology comparison. Faithfulness of ordinary forgetting proves the functor laws.
